runtime: node 22, express 4, ws; PostgreSQL 18 via openvibe-sdk/db (pg, or embedded PGlite in tests); Valkey optional; no build step
deployment: Production at https://openvibe.bot on openvibe-ovh since 2026-10-02: release layout /opt/openvibe.bot, unit openvibe-bot.service (WorkingDirectory /opt/openvibe.bot, EnvironmentFile /etc/openvibe/bot.env, PORT 4630, TimeoutStopSec 10), behind the nginx vhost deploy/nginx/openvibe.bot.conf, deployed with `ov deploy bot`. Liveness /api/health and readiness /api/ready are loopback-only.
features: device WebSocket /device: one outbound socket per machine, credential or Network node token, heartbeat and telemetry, commands never replayed after a reconnect

operator WebSocket /control and the REST API (/api/v1, including POST /robots/:id/commands so a bound channel's chat can forward a command over HTTP) over one command gate: roles, per-robot limits and allowlists, cooldowns and the turn budget
pairing with one-time codes, minted by Bot or delegated to OpenVibe.Network (BOT_PAIRING_AUTHORITY=network); a node machine binds on first use and reauths every 300 s
device credentials hashed at rest and rotatable; revoke closes the socket at once and revokes the Network principal for a node machine

catalogue profiles adeept.adr036 (+ mecanum variant), cozmo, looi, phone.camera, camera.onvif, sim.rover, relay.generic (the bare relay robot; OpenVibe.Live's old controls were converted to it and deleted from Live) and ros2.diffdrive / ros2.holonomic, seeded from server/profiles/*.json; owner-edited robot-local button and video-click profiles stored with each robot

ROS 2 robots: profiles ros2.diffdrive and ros2.holonomic (mapping driver plugin, plugin ros2; drive, camera, distance ahead, battery), installer --driver ros2 / ros2-holonomic; the device side is OpenVibe.Node's bundled ros2 plugin (cmd_vel Twist, BatteryState, Range/LaserScan, Odometry, CompressedImage; rclpy or rosbridge)

curated kit catalogue (server/kits/*.json; GET /api/v1/kits, /kits/:id): each kit's parts list and build guide, validated and bound to a shipped profile — the Adeept ADR036 first; metadata only (pricing, shipping and returns are O29)
a latched e-stop only the owner clears, with halt always allowed, and a device-side deadman deadline on the motion kinds
command audit kept 30 days, and the bot.robot.online/offline, bot.estop.set/cleared and bot.command.refused outbox events
public robot-profile catalogue (GET /profiles, /profiles/:id); robots are private to their owner, with public control only as a timed turn queue
per-actor limits on capability-boundary writes (openvibe-sdk/limits; shared through Valkey when VALKEY_URL is set)

signed-in pages: /robots/new (add), /pair/:id (the code and the one-paste installer command) and /panel/:id, rendered from the robot's profile and driven over /control; a sim.rover robot is driven by an in-process simulated device in a small arena shared with the browser (public/sim-world.js: walls and crates stop it; telemetry carries distance_cm, line sensors and its pose, from which the panel draws its camera and a map)

/try (public, no account): the real panel on a sim.rover that runs in the visitor's browser (public/try-device.js answers /control locally with the gate's value shaping, the deadman and the latched e-stop); listed in the sitemap and llms.txt

the robot directory (Frame pages, server/web/directory.js): public /robots (listed robots with online state, model and owner; every model; a signed-in person's own robots), /models and /models/:id (how it connects, setup steps, guide, panel controls), /r/:id (a listed robot's public page with its live embeddable panel), /robots/new (name, model choice grouped by connection kind, who may drive); owners list from the panel (POST /robots/:id/listing, robots.listed, migration 0009), listing turns on embed_public and unwatching unlists; listed robots and every model are in the sitemap

a phone as the robot (profile phone.camera, driver phone, Contracts 0.157.0): the pairing page's QR code (server/web/qr.js, qrcode-generator) opens /device/phone with the robot and code in the fragment; the phone pairs over POST /api/v1/pair and its browser is the device (public/phone-device.js): /device with the credential as the subprotocol ov.device.<credential>, the camera over WHIP to OpenRestream, say (speech synthesis), display (faces, text), torch, chime, battery and tilt telemetry, a local Stop (estop_state local_stop); /device/phone has its own CSP (the WHIP ingest origin) and Permissions-Policy camera=(self)

community robots (server/submissions.js, migration 0010): submit at /robots/submit (id community.<name>, driver plugin + mapping.plugin, Contracts 0.160.0, https driver and guide links, licence), status at /robots/submissions, admin review there (approve signs Ed25519 over canonical JSON with BOT_PROFILE_SIGNING_KEY and inserts robot_profiles; reject needs a note); GET /api/v1/profiles/:id carries the signature, GET /api/v1/profiles/signing-key the public key; /models lists them under From the community with credits; in the ADR-033 export, and deletion drops unapproved ones and keeps approved ones authorless

routines (server/routines.js, migration 0011): steps in plain lines parsed against the profile, run on demand, every N minutes (>= 5), daily at a UTC time on chosen days, or on bot.robot.online; each step through hub.operatorCommand as the owner, held steps re-sent within the deadman and released, a refusal stops it with its reason, one per robot at a time; panel card + /api/v1/robots/:id/routines

webhooks (server/webhooks.js, migration 0011): up to 5 https endpoints per robot for bot.robot.online/offline, bot.estop.set/cleared, bot.command.refused; whsec_ secret shown once; deliveries written in the emitting transaction, signed X-OpenVibe-Signature-V2 (openvibe-sdk/events), posted through the public-only poster with no redirects, retried 30 s/2/10/30/120 min then failed; panel card + /api/v1/robots/:id/webhooks

the owner's agent (migration 0012 robots.agent_control): panel 'Your agent' switch; svc:actor acting for the owner only reads GET /api/v1/robots/:id/steps (state + step words) and runs POST …/steps (<= 20 steps, <= 30 s, through hub.operatorCommand, audited as the service) or POST …/commands; otherwise 403 bot.agent_not_allowed

the panel's People card: the owner adds an operator or viewer by @username (OpenVibe.Network resolves the name to a subject) and removes them again, shown with Network's names; a signed-in visitor on an open-queue robot sees their turn or their place in line and can leave the queue, promoting the next person (POST /robots/:id/operators and …/operators/:subject/remove, POST /robots/:id/queue/leave)

panel input: a touch joystick, the keyboard and a gamepad (Gamepad API), each held control re-sent while held and zeroed at once on release; a latency meter (round-trip median and telemetry age); one camera tile per camera the profile lists, playing the robot's live OpenRestream WebRTC session (the Adeept and Cozmo profiles carry a camera widget since 2026-10-13); a readout shows the sensor keys the Node's drivers report (distance_cm, line, cliff and picked_up); a live online indicator on /pair/:id read from /control

platform.job@1 jobs dispatched to a paired Node over /device (platform.job-frame@1: resent unacked on reconnect, only to an advertised runtime class) and metered per second into run_usage_outbox for billing.usage.record

embed opt-in: robots.embed_public (migration 0005), set only by the owner with POST /robots/:id/embed, web-only (not in /api/v1); BOT_EMBED_ORIGINS is the validated frame-ancestors allow-list for the embeddable panel (default OpenVibe.Live)

embeddable panel: GET /panel/:id/embed framed only by BOT_EMBED_ORIGINS (no cookie, never a sign-in redirect; a member keeps their role, anyone else watches an embed_public robot) and the anonymous read-only /watch socket carrying the public state (online, e-stop, latency, battery, the profile's readouts), capped per address and per robot

streaming and recording toggles per robot, off by default and owner-only: media records live sessions to OpenVibe.Media (the OpenRestream stream's recording_mode vod/none) and live shows them on the owner's OpenVibe.Live channel (mirror_to_live), read at GET /api/v1/robots/:id/streaming and set at POST /api/v1/robots/:id/streaming; Bot stores no copy, each real change audits once

server-side ONVIF cameras (profile camera.onvif, driver onvif, server/onvif): an in-process device beside the simulator attaches a camera configured with BOT_ONVIF_CAMERAS (its URL plus username_ref/password_ref secret references, never in the profile or in clear), writes a real kind server device row, translates ptz commands to ONVIF ContinuousMove/Stop with the profile deadline as a deadman, and carries the camera's GetStatus readout in telemetry; every request goes only to the configured host, with a timeout and no redirects

a person's own machines that run their jobs (/machines: add with a --worker command, list, remove); their worker offers reported to Network as user-owned offers naming the owner; jobs reach a machine only for its owner (plan T14/T16)
